name: wispay-deploy-readiness
description: Complete WisPay (Reflex 0.9.8, Python 3.14) end-to-end per WisPay-doc and WisPay-deisgn. Switch dev DB from Azure SQL to SQLite, wire full domain logic + UI + lifecycle, and produce a deployable artifact.

tasks.subject: Spec + design lock (BS-1) — backend-engineer
tasks.description: Read every authoritative source (WisPay-doc/CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/, wispay-delivery-plan; WisPay-deisgn/DESIGN.md and assets/tokens.css; current WisPay/AGENTS.md, CONVENTIONS.md, docs/product/DESIGN.md) and produce `.scratch/wispay-deploy-build/implementation-tracker.md`. The tracker must cite CONTEXT.md invariants verbatim, list which files in the WisPay repo will be touched, the SQLite dev switch plan, the lifecycle coverage matrix, A1–A14 acceptance criteria translated to Reflex services + repository contracts, and resolutions for the prototype PRD's OPEN questions.
tasks.output:
BS-1 deliverable complete. Created `.scratch/wispay-deploy-build/implementation-tracker.md` (461 lines, 43 KB) that:

- §1 inventories 16 authoritative sources read across WisPay-doc, WisPay-deisgn, and the existing WisPay app (CONTEXT.md, wispay-delivery-plan, ADRs 0001–0008, payment-request-workflow research, docs/product/DESIGN.md, assets/design-tokens.css, prototype wispay-prd.md, CONVENTIONS.md, AGENTS.md, plus the existing models/services/pages/tests/rxconfig/pyproject baselines).
- §2 cites all 10 CONTEXT.md core invariants verbatim, with operational mappings to the existing code/tests in `WisPay\models\`, `WisPay\services\`, and `tests\`.
- §3 enumerates every file action across t1–t6 with reason, distinguishing existing/touched/new files (including pyproject.toml, db.py, sqlite_repositories.py, services/, pages/, components/, states/, demo_seed.py, scripts/validate.sh, Dockerfile, azure-deploy.bicep, A1–A14 e2e tests).
- §4 lifecycle coverage matrix covers all 14 canonical LifecycleState values from `WisPay\models\lifecycle.py` with transition owners, page surfaces, and acceptance ties.
- §5 SQLite dev switch plan keeps canonical-model invariants, adds parallel DDL block, conformance parity test, and a dev/prod driver precedence rule (`WISPAY_DB_URL` wins; if neither Azure nor SQLite env present, `RuntimeError` at lifespan start).
- §6 A1–A14 acceptance criteria mapped to services, repository contracts, pages, and tests.
- §7 resolutions for all 7 prototype PRD OPEN questions: (1) Reflex Python only — no vanilla flip, (2) lifecycle labels verbatim from ADR-0006, (3) doc-requirement matrix from reference_data.py, (4) thresholds from workflow_rules.seed_rules_v1, (5) 30-day reimbursement window as warning (not block), (6) brand-mark.svg reused, (7) no bulk actions beyond permission-scoped CSV export.
- §10 records open items not in scope: Buridan index fetch (t4), Entra IDP config (t5), Azure DI extraction (post-MVP), demo seed S01–S16 (t5), production IaC template (t6).

This is a work task (kind: "work"), not a quality gate, so no verdict/acceptanceResults/commandsRun are required. Output is concise summary; artifact path is `.scratch/wispay-deploy-build/implementation-tracker.md`.

tasks.subject: SQLite dev switch + dual-driver stores (BE-1)
tasks.description: Add SQLite store adapters mirroring the SQL ones; keep Azure SQL as production path; both behind the protocol contracts in WisPay/services/repositories.py; add scripts/sql/schema.sqlite.sql mirroring dbo.wispay_* tables; rewire rxconfig.py to pick URL from WS_DB_URL env var (default sqlite:///wispay.db); move pyodbc/msal to optional extras. Reproduce tests at WS_DB_URL=sqlite:///test.db without any Azure env vars.
tasks.output:
BE-1 complete. Dual-driver stores wired behind the existing Stores Protocol; Azure SQL remains the production path; SQLite is the dev default.

**In-scope changed paths:**
- pyproject.toml (move pyodbc + msal to optional extras `azure`, `entra`)
- WisPay/services/db.py (driver dispatch: default_db_url, driver_kind, sqlite_connect, sqlite_connect_in_memory, stores dispatcher)
- WisPay/services/sqlite_repositories.py (NEW — mirror of sql_repositories.py: SqliteRequestStore, SqliteWorkflowStore, SqliteAuditEventStore, SqliteRuleStore, sqlite_stores; uses INSERT…ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE for atomic upserts; reuses sql_repositories parameter builders for canonical-model parity)
- WisPay/services/runtime.py (caches either driver; reconnect probe handles both sqlite3 + pyodbc; module-level _sql_stores/_sqlite_stores symbols for monkeypatch)
- rxconfig.py (WS_DB_URL first, then Azure SQL env, then sqlite:///wispay.db)
- .env.example (WS_DB_URL precedence documented; azure/entra extras referenced)
- scripts/sql/schema.sqlite.sql (NEW — SQLite DDL mirroring dbo.wispay_*)
- scripts/validate.sh (defaults WS_DB_URL=sqlite:///./.wispay-validate.db; exports + cleanup on exit; falls back to .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m when uv missing)
- tests/services/test_db_sqlite.py (NEW — 8 tests: URL resolution, default fallback, connection assembly, schema dispatch)
- tests/services/test_sqlite_repositories.py (NEW — 11 tests: request/workflow/audit/rule round-trip, hash chain, money precision)
- tests/services/test_runtime.py (module-level symbol patching; SQLite reconnect probe)
- tests/services/test_db.py (clear WS_DB_URL in _clear_sql_env so Azure tests keep targeting Azure path)
- .scratch/wispay-deploy-build/implementation-tracker.md (added §11 t2 status)

**Verification:**
- `WS_DB_URL=sqlite:///test.db` with NO Azure env vars → bash scripts/validate.sh → 203 passed, 9 deselected (e2e); ruff lint + format + mypy all pass.
- Default `WS_DB_URL=sqlite:///./.wispay-validate.db` (no Azure env) → same green result.
- Driver precedence locked: WS_DB_URL > AZURE_SQL_{SERVER,DATABASE} env > sqlite:///wispay.db.
- All four stores satisfy the existing Stores Protocol unchanged; services do not need to know the driver.

tasks.subject: Service layer wired to stores (BE-2)
tasks.description: Wire request_creation, request_query, approval_workflow, audit_trail, workflow_rules, reference_data, user_context, authentication against the new SQLite/SQL stores; enforce CONTEXT.md SoD invariants in services (requester cannot approve own; only authorized Finance records payment; no hard deletes). Unit tests land in tests/services using both FakeStores and SqliteStores.
tasks.output:
BE-2 complete. All services from the t3 contract (request_creation, request_query, approval_workflow, audit_trail, workflow_rules, reference_data, user_context, authentication) are wired to the new Stores Protocol and run against both FakeStores and SqliteStores. CONTEXT.md invariants 3, 7, 8, 9, 10 are enforced in services with explicit tests; no hard-deletes on payment records.

**In-scope changed paths (15):**
- WisPay/services/repositories.py (PaymentRecordStore Protocol + payments slot in Stores bundle)
- WisPay/services/db.py (wispay_payment_record table + index in Azure SQL DDL)
- WisPay/services/sqlite_repositories.py (wispay_payment_record table + SqlitePaymentRecordStore)
- WisPay/services/sql_repositories.py (SqlPaymentRecordStore + payment_record_insert_params)
- WisPay/services/payment_recording.py (NEW: start_payment, record_payment, SoD guards)
- WisPay/services/audit_trail.py (InMemoryAuditTrail.append now accepts reason)
- scripts/sql/schema.sql (+ wispay_payment_record)
- scripts/sql/schema.sqlite.sql (+ wispay_payment_record)
- tests/services/test_db.py (expected tables)
- tests/services/test_db_sqlite.py (expected tables)
- tests/services/test_sqlite_repositories.py (PaymentRecordStore protocol check)
- tests/services/fakes.py (FakePaymentRecordStore + payments slot)
- tests/services/test_payment_recording.py (NEW: 15 invariant tests)
- tests/services/test_service_wiring.py (NEW: 4 end-to-end integration tests)
- .scratch/wispay-deploy-build/implementation-tracker.md (§12 added)

**Verification:**
- WS_DB_URL=sqlite:///test.db + no Azure env → bash scripts/validate.sh → 222 passed, 9 deselected (e2e); ruff + mypy + format all pass.
- WS_DB_URL=sqlite:///./.wispay-validate.db (validate.sh default) → same green result.

**ContEXT invariants enforced (with tests):**
- Invariant 3 (self-approval): approval_workflow.decide raises SelfApprovalError.
- Invariant 7 (only approved → payment in process): payment_recording.start_payment guards APPROVED state.
- Invariant 8 (only authorized Finance records payment): payment_recording requires PAYMENT_OPERATOR_ROLES; requester-vs-operator hard denied.
- Invariant 9 (recorded amount = approved amount, no money movement): Money-equality comparison; external reference required; no transfer / debit / sent language.
- Invariant 10 (no hard-deletes on financial records): PaymentRecordStore Protocol exposes save + for_request only; SqlitePaymentRecordStore and FakePaymentRecordStore have no delete/update methods.
